units.source_text: 鹤川辞世三年后，柏木让我读这几封信，他的用意是非常明显的。

en.t: Three years after Tsurukawa died, Kashiwagi made me read these letters, and his intention was perfectly clear.

units.source_text: 我虽然受到如此的冲击，但他少年时躺在茂盛的夏草上，

en.t: Although I was shaken so deeply, the scene of him as a boy lying in the lush summer grass,

units.source_text: 阳光透过叶缝隙流泻下来的斑斑点点地落在他的白衬衫上的情景，并没有从我的记忆中消褪。

en.t: with sunlight streaming through gaps in the leaves and falling in scattered patches on his white shirt, had not faded from my memory.

units.source_text: 鹤川作古了，三年后他这样地变形，托付于他的东西同死一起消失了。

en.t: Tsurukawa was dead, and three years later he had been transformed in this way; what had been entrusted to him had vanished together with death.

units.source_text: 这一瞬间，这些东西却反而以另一种现实性复苏了。

en.t: Yet in that instant, those things revived instead with another kind of reality.

units.source_text: 比起记忆的意义来，我更相信记忆的实质。

en.t: More than the meaning of memory, I believed in the substance of memory.

units.source_text: 因为我确信，不信赖它的话，生的本身就势必处在崩溃的状态……

en.t: For I was convinced that if one did not trust it, life itself would inevitably remain in a state of collapse...

units.source_text: 柏木俯视着我，他满足于地的手竟敢对精神进行杀戮。

en.t: Kashiwagi looked down at me; his contented, earthly hand had dared to commit murder against the spirit.
